book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: APOCALIPSIS Tachi Ak'õrepa k'awapida San Juanmaa

content: Oveja Chak'epa ma seis eerepema tauchaada ogat'aak'ãri, ɨt'aripemaarã jõmaweda k'ĩuu nɨ̃beeji. Mãgá p'aneejida perá hora esa-auk'a.
Ma t'ẽepai mɨa unuji angeleerã siete, iru k'ĩrapite bainɨ̃ p'anapataarã. Mãgɨ́ chaa trompeta ãchi chaachaa jitajida.

Mãpai ángel awaraa cheji mãik'aapa bainɨ̃ beeji altar k'ait'a. Ichi juade k'uuruk'a bɨ nẽedee ooda iru baji. Aɨde ne-inaa t'ũa bapari paapachida Tachi Ak'õre-it'ee. Awaraapa irumaa ne-inaa t'ũa bapari waibɨa teeji, p'oiramerã Cristodeerã ɨt'aa t'ɨ̃pata ome mãik'aapa bɨmerã ma altar ɨ̃rɨ Tachi Ak'õre-it'ee. Mãgɨ́ bɨji altar nẽedee ooda ɨ̃rɨ; ma altar rey su-ak'ɨ beepari k'ĩrapite bainɨ̃ bɨ.
Ma ne-inaa t'ũa bapari paak'ãri, chi nari Cristodeerã ɨt'aa t'ɨ̃pata ome ma ángel juadeepa ɨt'aa wãji Tachi Ak'õre baparimãi.

Mãpai ma angelpa t'ɨpɨtau atap'eda altardeepa, ma k'uuruk'a bɨ ipurut'aaji. Mãpai bat'at'aaji na p'ek'au eujãdee. Mãga oo bɨde mɨa ũriji pa jĩwaa nɨ̃bɨ pedee ome. Ichiaba unuji pa tau p'orep'orepari mãik'aapa na p'ek'au eujã wëre nɨ̃bɨ awẽrachaipa.
Mãpai ma angeleerã sieteerãpa trompeta iru p'anɨ ãchi juade ewaa jirajida chaadait'ee.

Chi naapɨara angelpa ichi trompeta chaak'ãri, angeleerãpa hielo k'oi tauk'a bat'ajida na p'ek'au eujãdee. Ma hielo p'oira baji t'ɨpɨtau ome mãik'aapa waa ome. Perá eujã esajĩak'a paadachi. Ichiaba pak'uru õpeedepema chaa aba mãik'aapa p'ũajara jõmaweda paadachi.
Araarepema angelpa ichi trompeta chaak'ãri, mãu choma t'ɨpɨtau ome urua nɨ̃bɨ bat'ajida p'usa jãdee. Mãpai perá p'usa jã esajĩak'a waa padachi.
Ma awara p'usadepema ne-inaa chok'ai bɨ õpeedepema chaa aba piudachida. Ichiaba barco p'usade wã nipadap'edaa, mãgɨ́ õpeedepema chaa aba jõdachida.
Ma omé eerepema angelpa ichi trompeta chaak'ãri, lucero choma t'ɨpɨtau ome urua nɨ̃bɨ pajãdeepa baaidachi na eujãdepema to mãik'aapa pania poatrɨ uchiapata ɨ̃rɨ; ma õpeedepema chaa aba ɨ̃rɨ.
Mãgɨ́ t'ɨ̃jarapata Lucero Asia. Mãgɨ́ baaik'ãri, to mãik'aapa pania poatrɨ uchiapata õpeedepema chaa aba ɨ̃rɨ, pania asia ũu beeji. Eperãarãpa ma pania todak'ãri, chok'ara piujida.

Ma õpee eerepema angelpa ichi trompeta chaak'ãri, ak'õrejĩru, atane, lucero ãridachida. Perá ak'õrejĩru k'ĩra esajĩak'a k'ĩidachi. Perá atane k'ĩra esajĩak'a auk'a k'ĩidachi. Ichiaba perá lucero esa-auk'a k'ĩidachida. Mapa ãstaawa hora õpeedepema chaa aba ak'õrejĩru jẽra-e paji. Ichiaba p'ãrik'ua hora õpeedepema chaa aba atane lucero ome ɨ̃daada-e paji.

Mãpai mɨa unuji nejɨ̃pɨ pajãde ɨt'ɨ́ wãabai ni. Ũriji ma nejɨ̃pɨpa golpe pedeeru: —¡Aai, eperãarã at'ãri eujãde p'anɨ audú chupɨria jõnadait'eeda aji, apema angeleerã õpeerãpa ãchi trompeta chaadak'ãri!
